arms.predicted: SA solution with grid-based NN construction, NN-guided 2-opt with efficient penalty delta computation, Or-opt moves, and prime-scheduling post-pass will score higher than the baseline probe of 33.5
arms.observed: Score = 78.881, a 2.35x improvement over the NN+limited-SA baseline of 33.456. The efficient penalty delta (O(segment/10) instead of O(segment)) enabled NN-guided 2-opt with large segments up to 5000, dramatically improving solution quality.

discrepancy_analysis: Prediction confirmed. The SA with NN-guided 2-opt and efficient penalty delta computation scored 78.88, well above the 33.5 baseline probe. Key mechanism: NN-guided move selection focused 2-opt on pairs of cities that are close in Euclidean space but far apart in tour order — exactly the most productive improvements. The efficient delta computation (only checking penalty positions at every 10th step) enabled evaluation of much larger segments than full O(N) recompute.
